messages:
Maya: Kickoff: SereneBio onboarding. Quick goal: align owners, define success metrics, and map a 30/60 plan. Renewal window noted for 2028-Q1.
Elliot (SereneBio): Thanks Maya. We9re most concerned about PII handling and latency for clinical Q&A. Core use: embeddings + chat.
Jon: I9ll take data pipeline + transform. Need a redacted sample CSV and retention requirements. ETA for initial ingest in 10 business days once we have files.
Sam: Platform will provision a sandbox cluster and a staging model. Will need network allowlist and a list of IPs. Can do infra prep in 3 days after allowlist.
Quinn (Security): PII + HIPAA flag. We need classification of fields before ingest. If customer wants hosted, they9ll need a Business Associate Agreement. I9ll send checklist.
Maya: Proposed success criteria: 1) Sandbox end-to-end (ingest, embeddings, chat) with redacted dataset; 2) SSO + 3 test users; 3) Staging median p50 latency <400ms; 4) Compliance checklist signed; 5) KT recorded. Ok?
Elliot (SereneBio): Good. One ask: 12-month audit log retention and ability to extract logs for audits.
Quinn (Security): We can do 12m retention on Dedicated or Private. For Hosted, will propose retention add-on and export process.
Jon: Can SereneBio share a sample prompt set (50 exemplars) and a schema? Also any blocking fields we should redact?
Elliot (SereneBio): Will share by EOD Tue. We9ll redact direct identifiers and flag sensitive columns.
Maya: Risks: 1) delayed sample data (blocks pipeline); 2) missing allowlist (blocks infra); 3) model quality gap after quantization; 4) contract delays (BAA).
Maya: Action items and owners:
- Elliot: provide redacted sample + prompt set (due Tue)
- Jon: ingest scaffold + mapping doc (due Fri)
- Sam: sandbox infra + allowlist confirmation (due Thu)
- Quinn: BAA checklist + retention options (due Wed)
- Maya: set weekly sync and create onboarding doc (due today)
deploy-bot: Meeting created: "SereneBio Onboarding - Weekly" Thurs 09:00 PT starting 3780013000
Jon: Quick infra snippet we9ll need from customer:
```
BUCKET=serenebio-sandbox
PREFIX=uploads/
REDACTED_FIELDS=id,email
```
Elliot (SereneBio): Copy. I9ll DM creds to Jon and ping our legal for the BAA.
Maya: I9ll share a Confluence onboarding checklist in this thread once available. Also flagging renewal exposure: if usage spikes >750k tokens/mo, we escalate to AM for pricing review.
Sam: We9ll also run an early perf matrix (p50/p90) and share recommended batching.
Quinn (Security): Note: plan a security review before go-live. Recommend Privileged Access review for deployment team.
Maya: Thanks everyone. Weekly cadence: Thurs 09:00 PT. If urgent, please DM.
Elliot (SereneBio): Appreciate it 2:thumbsup:
Maya: Leaving notes here as we progress. Next post: onboarding doc + invite link.
